name: prism-uorc
title: Prism UORC
purpose: Decides whether one object may be kept in, or opened from, the owner's browser as a UORC archive (UOR-Foundation/compression): the archive is the object's reference, a lossless executable structure sealed by UORC-SHA256-CHAIN-v1, named by the kappa label of the bytes it restores. The decision reads only the archive's structure (its seal, format, scope, object count, whether it restored to the very bytes its label names, and the kappa facet's answer), never the content: values are projected only when the decision says open.

fields.name: act
fields.means: keep: the vault is about to keep the object as this archive; open: the vault is about to give the object back from this archive

fields.name: seal
fields.means: the archive's UORC-SHA256-CHAIN-v1 integrity seal checks (inspect's integrity_ok), read without decoding

fields.name: format
fields.means: the archive's format and machine profile are the ones the pinned client writes (format 2, profile 1)

fields.name: scope
fields.means: self-contained; conditional on the standard basis the pinned client carries (named by its identity in site/uorc/uorc.lock.json); or conditional on any other basis, which the browser does not hold

fields.name: objects
fields.means: the archive restores exactly one object, the one its kappa label names

fields.name: restore
fields.means: the archive decoded within the client's work bound to the very bytes its kappa label names (same), to other bytes, or not at all

fields.name: kappa
fields.means: the kappa facet's answer for the restored bytes under their label: admit, or anything else

guarantees.why: the kill switch stops every keep and open
an archive whose seal does not check is no reference
only the pinned client's format and profile are read
an archive conditional on a basis the browser does not hold cannot be checked here
one archive is one object under one kappa label
an archive that restores other bytes than its label names is never kept or opened
an archive that does not decode within the work bound is never kept or opened
an object the kappa facet did not admit has no reference in the Prism
keeping never projects the object's values
a sound archive of an admitted object is kept
a sound archive of an admitted object is opened
a sound archive of an admitted object is kept
a sound archive of an admitted object is opened
